study_design: Prospective cohort study using Cox proportional hazards models in the Japan Collaborative Cohort study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 15,471 Japanese men participating in the Japan Collaborative Cohort study completed a questionnaire including food intake.
reason: The abstract reports 143 incident prostate cancers and analyzes overall prostate cancer risk. It does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Beta-carotene intake was not associated with the risk of prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The beta-carotene row concerns overall incident prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype. The numeric estimate is supplied by full-text evidence, while the abstract supports the general endpoint classification.
